recordedProductIssues: Review screen overlaid lock-icon boxes and checklist are tiny at feed size
Name field left unmasked as the product recorded it

defects.problem: Cursor appears at the top-left of the screenshot, then jumps to the Name field next frame; reads as a stray jump.
defects.fix: Trim the cursor move or cut to the segment where the cursor is already near the Name field.

defects.problem: Six frames almost unchanged; the redaction story (masks, checklist) is invisible at feed size and the screen text is unreadable.
defects.fix: Trim the hold; the wording itself carries the point.

defects.problem: The right column below the checklist is empty while the caption stack at the bottom is dense with three text sizes.
defects.fix: Centre the checklist vertically in the available column.

defects.problem: Change to the 'exact upload' view shifts the screen size and position slightly, which is a layout jump and not a clean match.
defects.fix: Align the upload frame to the same screen rect as the review frame.

oneLineVerdict: Clear, honest privacy beat with a good before and after, held back by dead hold time and small feed-size text.
